blocks.text: This page is mainly a hinge and must be repaired as the opening of Episode 89, clearly marking that the Nawab Kapoor Singh material is ending and a new conflict is being introduced.

The anchor is explicit: Episode 89 begins with the episode of mulkhayyas, bivastc, and dini Khudâin ki, where Muslim zeal, clerical pressure, and political mobilization gather into a fresh anti-Khalsa campaign.
From there the page should set up Aslam Khan at Lahore and the wider religious agitation around him, serving as the clean bridge from episode 88 into the next martial and ideological confrontation.
